summary.text: Adam Bird is a Republican state representative from Ohio House of Representatives District 63 who is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 ballot. A former teacher, principal and superintendent, he serves on the Education and Finance committees.

paragraphs.text: Bird was born in New Richmond, Ohio, where he lives.
His career experience includes working as a teacher, principal and superintendent.

In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired educator with 33 years in education who was concerned about Common Core and over-testing of students and supported parents’ right to choose the best educational option for their children.
Bird has served in the Ohio House since 2021, after defeating Alicia Gee in the 2020 general election for District 66.
As the incumbent, he won re-election in District 63 in 2022 over Richard Perry and in 2024 over Tracey McCullough.
In the 2025–2026 session he was assigned to the Education, Finance, General Government, Public Insurance and Pensions, and Rules and Reference committees.
